raw_responses.Bulgarian:
DESCRIPTION: Фигурата е озаглавена "Massive Activation of baseline" и илюстрира промените на максималната стойност на активацията в зависимост от слоя на модела за четири различни серии данни. Оста X е обозначена като "Layer", има линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23 и етикети, разположени през интервал от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като "Max Activation Value", също с линейна скала, обхващаща диапазон от 0 до 1600, с етикети през 200 единици.

Първата линия, "attn_output", е синя, пунктирана с тире-точка стил и маркери, които не са ясно различими. Тя остава близо до 0 от слой 0 до приблизително слой 20, след което рязко нараства до около 600 при слой 23.

Втората линия, "attn_residual", е оранжева с точков (пунктиран) стил. Тя остава близо до 0 от слой 0 до приблизително слой 4–5, след което рязко нараства до около 1400 при слой 6, продължава да се покачва леко до около 1500 при слой 8–9, задържа се на приблизително 1500 до слой 20, след което рязко спада до около 400–600 при слой 23.

Третата линия, "ffn_output", е зелена с тире-точка стил. Тя остава близо до 0 от слой 0 до слой 4, рязко нараства до около 1400 при слой 5, след което бързо спада обратно до близо 0 при слой 7. Линията остава близо до 0 до приблизително слой 12–13, където отново се покачва рязко до около 500 при слой 13, след което отново спада до близо 0 при слой 15 и остава ниска до слой 23.

Четвъртата линия, "ffn_residual", е червена с плътен стил. Тя остава близо до 0 от слой 0 до слой 4–5, след което рязко нараства до около 1500 при слой 6, задържа се на приблизително 1500–1570 от слой 6 до слой 20, като достига видим връх от около 1570 в участъка между слоеве 13 и 20, след което рязко спада до около 400 при слой 23.
raw_responses.Chinese:
This figure, titled "Massive Activation of baseline," displays the maximum activation value across different layers of a neural network for four distinct data series. The x-axis represents "Layer," scaled linearly from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis represents "Max Activation Value," scaled linearly from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at intervals of 200. The first series, "attn_output," is shown as a blue dashed line with no visible markers; it remains near 0 from layer 0 through approximately layer 20, then rises sharply to around 600 by layer 23. The second series, "attn_residual," is depicted as an orange dotted line; it stays near 0 until approximately layer 5, where it rises steeply to around 1400, continues increasing gradually to approximately 1500 by layer 10, remains relatively flat near 1500 through layer 20, and then drops sharply to around 200 by layer 23. The third series, "ffn_output," is shown as a green dash-dot line; it remains near 0 until layer 5, spikes sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, then drops back to near 0 around layer 7, stays near 0 until approximately layer 13, spikes again to around 500 near layer 13–14, drops back to near 0 around layer 15, remains low through layer 20, and then rises to approximately 600 by layer 23. The fourth series, "ffn_residual," is displayed as a red solid line; it stays near 0 from layer 0 to approximately layer 5, rises steeply to around 1500 at layer 5, plateaus near 1550 from roughly layer 7 through layer 20, and then drops sharply to approximately 400 by layer 23.

raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: This plot, titled "Massive Activation of baseline," illustrates the maximum activation values across different transformer layers for four distinct activation types. The x-axis represents "Layer," scaled linearly from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents "Max Activation Value," scaled linearly from 0 to 1600. Four lines are shown. The blue dashed line with no visible markers represents "attn_output," which remains near 0 from layer 0 through approximately layer 20, then rises sharply to around 600 by layer 23. The orange dotted line represents "attn_residual," which stays near 0 until approximately layer 5, where it rises steeply to around 1400, then continues increasing gradually to approximately 1500–1550 through layers 6 to 20, before dropping sharply to near 0 around layer 21 and then rising again to approximately 600 by layer 23. The green dash-dot line represents "ffn_output," which remains near 0 until layer 5, spikes sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, then drops back to near 0 around layer 7, rises again to approximately 400–500 between layers 13 and 15, returns to near 0 from layers 16 to 20, and then increases sharply to around 600 at layer 23. The red solid line represents "ffn_residual," which stays near 0 from layer 0 to approximately layer 4, rises steeply to around 1500 at layer 5, remains relatively flat at approximately 1500–1550 from layers 6 through 20, then drops sharply to approximately 400 around layer 21 before rising slightly to around 600 at layer 23.
raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Dieses Diagramm zeigt die maximale Aktivierungswerte über verschiedene Schichten eines Baseline-Modells, betitelt „Massive Activation of baseline". Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet und erstreckt sich auf einer linearen Skala von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Max Activation Value" beschriftet und reicht auf einer linearen Skala von 0 bis 1600, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 200. Es werden vier Datenreihen dargestellt. Die Linie „attn_output" ist blau, gestrichelt mit Strich-Punkt-Muster und verläuft von nahe 0 bei Layer 0 bis etwa Layer 20 nahe 0, steigt dann steil an und erreicht bei Layer 23 einen Wert von etwa 600. Die Linie „attn_residual" ist orange und gepunktet; sie bleibt von Layer 0 bis etwa Layer 4 nahe 0, steigt dann steil auf etwa 1400 bei Layer 5 an, erreicht bei etwa Layer 7 einen Wert von ungefähr 1500, hält dieses Niveau bis etwa Layer 20 und fällt dann bei Layer 21 auf etwa 400 ab, bevor sie bei Layer 23 wieder auf etwa 600 ansteigt. Die Linie „ffn_output" ist grün mit Strich-Punkt-Muster; sie bleibt von Layer 0 bis etwa Layer 4 nahe 0, springt bei Layer 5 auf etwa 1400, fällt dann bei Layer 6 auf nahe 0 zurück, bleibt niedrig bis etwa Layer 12, steigt bei Layer 13 auf etwa 500 an, fällt bei Layer 15 wieder auf nahe 0, bleibt niedrig bis Layer 20 und steigt bei Layer 23 auf etwa 600 an. Die Linie „ffn_residual" ist rot und durchgezogen; sie verläuft von nahe 0 bei Layer 0, steigt bei Layer 5 steil auf etwa 1400 an, erreicht bei etwa Layer 7 einen Wert von ungefähr 1550 und hält dieses Plateau bis etwa Layer 20, wo sie steil auf etwa 400 bei Layer 21 abfällt und bei Layer 23 auf etwa 600 ansteigt.
